title.headline: 16.1% of employees left - where, why, and what HR can do
title.sub: Power BI | Power Query | DAX | Excel - IBM HR sample data (fictional), one point-in-time snapshot
title.notes: The question: why do people leave, and what can HR and L&D do about it? The answer comes from a Power BI dashboard built on the IBM HR sample.

data.title: From a raw CSV to a self-testing Power BI model
data.callout_sub: Every displayed number was compared with an independent calculation from the raw CSV
data.notes: Each stage is validated before the next one starts. The model also tests itself on every refresh (Data Quality page).

model.title: A star schema built for slicing
points: 9 one-to-many relationships, dimension to fact - no ambiguous paths
33 DAX measures with DIVIDE, KEEPFILTERS and a REMOVEFILTERS company baseline
35 QA checks recalculated on every refresh
PBIP / TMDL text format: reviewable in Git and rebuildable from scripts
model.notes: Why a star schema on one flat file: clean slicers, simple DAX, and room to add real HR tables later.

findings.title: Overtime and the first year stand out
points: higher attrition with overtime (30.5% vs 10.4%); odds ratio 5.0 after controls
attrition in the first 0-1 years when combined with overtime
Sales Representatives vs the company rate
findings.foot: Performance rating does not predict attrition (16.4% Outstanding vs 16.1% others). Associations in a snapshot, not proven causes.
findings.notes: Overtime goes with higher attrition in 8 of 9 job roles, within roles (odds ratio 4.3) and in a logistic regression with tenure, satisfaction, job level, stock options and other factors (odds ratio 5.0).

recs.title: Four actions to pilot, one data fix
cards: Monthly overtime reviews and workload rebalancing, starting with the highest-risk roles
90-day onboarding, a mentor for every new hire, front-loaded learning
Track: Early Tenure Attrition Rate (0-1 yrs)
Pay and incentive benchmark, career path to Sales Executive (39.8% attrition today)
Quarterly pulse survey, manager follow-up within 30 days
recs.data_fix: Data fix: record course type, hours and completion, calibrate performance ratings, and add dates to measure whether the actions work.
recs.notes: Each action has a measure in the dashboard to track it. Run them as pilots with a comparison group, because the data shows associations, not causes.
